# Test: Sample — listening
id: sample-listening
time: 20
strand: listening

## Section 1
figure: centre-plan | The visitor centre, ground floor
### Passage: CD1 Track 3 (transcript — students never see this)
WOMAN: Riverside Visitor Centre, good morning.
MAN: Hello. I'm bringing a school group on the fourteenth of June, and I wanted
to check a few things before I book.
WOMAN: Of course. How many children?
MAN: Twenty-eight, plus four adults. They're all twelve years old.
WOMAN: Fine. The group rate is four pounds fifty a child, and the adults come in
free as supervisors. Lunch isn't included, but you can use the picnic room.
MAN: Where is that?
WOMAN: As you come through the main entrance, it's the first room on your right.
The shop is opposite it, and the cafe is at the far end on the river side.
MAN: And the room with the fish tanks — my class is doing river habitats.
WOMAN: That's the aquarium, next to the cafe. Ask for Sanjay when you arrive; he
runs the habitats talk at eleven o'clock, and it lasts about forty minutes.

Q. Cost for each child: £___

H. On the day
Q. Ask for ___ at the desk

Q. The habitats talk lasts about ___ minutes

## Section 2
### Passage: CD1 Track 4 (transcript — students never see this)
Good afternoon, everyone. Before the walk begins, three quick points. First, the
path along the north bank is closed this week, so we'll follow the south bank
instead. Second, please keep dogs on a lead near the bird hide — the nesting
season has just started. And third, if it rains heavily we'll cut the walk short
at the old bridge rather than continue to the weir.

### Questions: mcq
instructions: Choose the correct letter, A, B or C.

Q. Which path will the group follow today?
A) The north bank
B) The south bank
C) Both banks
A. B
W. "the path along the north bank is closed … we'll follow the south bank."

Q. Why must dogs be kept on a lead?
A) The path is narrow
B) Birds are nesting
C) There are sheep nearby
A. B
W. "keep dogs on a lead near the bird hide — the nesting season has just started."

B. The walk follows the south bank
C. The walk continues to the weir

Q. It rains heavily

Q. The north bank is closed
